# Example marketplace
A fictional marketplace used as the first real-shape discovery fixture.

Hosted on Vercel; `proj_Ab12Cd34Ef56` is the linked project.
Supabase holds the data and auth. The project ref `abcdefghij0123456789` is in the dashboard.
Run `supabase start` for the local stack.
Resend sends email; its domain id is 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000.
GitHub Actions runs the checks on every push.
Vitest and Playwright cover the tests.
Cloudflare manages DNS for the apex domain.
Add error monitoring in Phase 2.
